about: Who may sign feedback on this site: the enrolled keys (a handle, a role and the key's fingerprints; never a name unless the person agreed) and the invitations they came from (only a hash of each). Invitations are made in the browser, on /join/invite/, signed by an enrolled key that may invite; a key is enrolled automatically when its enrolment and its invitation both verify. Kept by conductor@php.newsroom; the brief is admin/content/briefs/2026-10-22__brief__feedback-keys-and-review.md.
roles: The editor: his feedback and reviews come first, and the review queue is his
A member of the team that runs the site
A power user: reads what is new when asked, and says what works
